'''Thanta Zilbra''' was a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who crashed on a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with a native [[Fungus/Legends|fungus]] with tremendous healing properties. Obtaining sponsorship from the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], Zilbra established a colony on the planet, now known as [[Thanta Zilbra (planet)|Thanta Zilbra]] to harvest [[Zilbra fungus]]. Zilbra was killed when the planet was destroyed during the [[Corellian Crisis]], but did insist his four sons and two daughters evacuate.<ref name="CTD" />
